# Collin Nerdahl

> Builds systems and tests them against reality. Fifteen years running a factory floor, over twenty years in the markets, now AI agent systems. Based in Ontario, Canada.

## What he offers
- Custom systems for discretionary traders, built around how they already trade: https://primefoldtrading.com
- TradingView indicators, built and tested: https://www.tradingview.com/u/CollinNerdahl/
- AI agent systems built with the same quality checks a production line runs: https://primefold.tools
- Andon, an open-source guard that stops a coding agent from saying "done" without proof: https://github.com/PrimeFoldTools/andon

## Background
- 2009 to 2024: Active Playground Equipment, from CNC technician to production manager. Sales grew from $650K to over $3M a year. Led the production teams and owned the final check before every job shipped.
- Over twenty years investing: startups, alternative investments, commodities, stocks, crypto, options, real estate.
- Over nine years trading.
- Building AI agent systems since 2023.

## Projects
- PrimeFold Tools (company): tools that make AI agents prove their work. https://primefold.tools

- Hidden Heuristics: essays on the hidden rules we run on. https://hiddenheuristics.substack.com
